title: Finishing a Journey pays the completion Gems its card shows

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
Journeys show completion Gems (the author sets them, the discovery card prints them) and nothing paid them since the Quest completion model retired the lesson-tree grant. Owner ruling 2026-11-18: pay them. The completion engine now pays the plan's completion_gems on a fresh finish, once per member per Journey, through a reward_grants claim (journey.finish.gems:<planId>).

DONE 2026-11-18.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
